faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulwadood?
faq.a: Abdulwadood is associated with Arabic. Abdulwadood is Arabic عَبْدُ الْوَدُود (ʿAbd al-Wadūd), meaning 'servant of the Loving'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْوَدُود is Arabic.
Abdulwadood can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulwadood should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Wadūd is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
